items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 40th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 85 while the rest average 46 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 85/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: A whale shed 4.00M SPX in 7 days
items.detail: 0x85de…598b distributed over the window, one of 6 whales net-selling.
items.framing: A large wallet distributed 4.00M SPX in 7 days. State it as a move off this wallet — it may be a split (see clustering), not a market sell.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-4.9% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 8.02M SPX. 4w -1.3% · 12w -4.9% · 26w -10.7%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-4.9% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: 1 new proven top-timer in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 1 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.detail: 0xc044…d859 accumulated over the window, one of 4 whales net-buying.

items.headline: 4.16M SPX left in a day
items.detail: 2026-09-04: 89 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 4.16M SPX, 4.5σ above the usual churn — 61% in profit (profit-taking).
items.framing: A profit-taking exit wave — 89 wallets banked 4.16M SPX and stepped down. Holders selling strength, not fear; the honest hook is WHO takes profit and when.
items.checkable: Wallets whose balance fell below the 5k residency bar that day, split by exit vs entry price.

items.detail: 0xb39a…3374 is the biggest net buyer of Project AEON over 30 days — 2.4 ETH ($5,780), well clear of the field.
items.framing: One wallet accumulated 4 AEON (~$5,780) on the market. Show the tornado / the city arcs — anyone can verify it.

items.headline: Supply is spreading out of the top 100
items.detail: Top-100 share is 56.4% of holder supply, 1.6σ down vs its month.
items.framing: The largest 100 wallets gave up share this month (56.4%, 1.6σ). Broadening holder base — decentralising.
items.checkable: Top-100 addresses' share of tracked supply, from the transfer history.

items.headline: Price is 1.19× the crowd's cost basis
items.detail: Spot $0.590 vs realized price $0.498 — the average holder is in profit (MVRV 1.19).

items.headline: 67% of supply is in profit
items.detail: 67% of tracked supply is held above its on-chain cost basis today.
items.framing: 67% of supply is in profit. Low = capitulation zone, high = euphoria risk; a position read, not a signal.
